title.en: SAT R&W: Transitions: time order, examples and added points
title.uz: SAT R&W: Transitions — vaqt tartibi, misol va qoʻshimcha fikr
title.ru: SAT R&W: Transitions — порядок во времени, пример и добавление

body.en:
Lesson 1 named five kinds of link. This lesson takes two of them further: time order, and an example against an added point.
Time order. When the sentences tell events, ask when the second one happens:
• after the first: Then, Next, Later, Afterward
• before the first: Previously, Earlier (before that)
• at the same time: Meanwhile
• the last of several steps: Finally
Example or addition? Ask what the second sentence does with the first:
• it shows one case of the first sentence's idea: For example, For instance
• it brings a new point of the same kind: In addition, Moreover
Example: "The new playground in the mahalla has two swings and a slide. ___, a small free library opened next to it in May." The library is not a case of the playground; it is a second new thing for the families, so the link is addition: "In addition,".
body.uz:
1-darsda bogʻlanishning besh turini koʻrdik. Bu dars ulardan ikkitasini chuqurroq oʻrgatadi: vaqt tartibi hamda misol bilan qoʻshimcha fikrning farqi.
Vaqt tartibi. Gaplar voqealarni aytsa, ikkinchi voqea qachon boʻlganini aniqlang:
• birinchisidan keyin: Then, Next, Later, Afterward
• birinchisidan oldin: Previously, Earlier (bundan oldin)
• ayni bir vaqtda: Meanwhile
• bir necha qadamning oxirgisi: Finally
Misolmi yoki qoʻshimchami? Ikkinchi gap birinchisi bilan nima qilishini aniqlang:
• birinchi gapdagi fikrning bitta holatini koʻrsatadi: For example, For instance
• xuddi shu turdagi yangi fikrni qoʻshadi: In addition, Moreover
Misol: «The new playground in the mahalla has two swings and a slide. ___, a small free library opened next to it in May.» Kutubxona maydonchaning bir holati emas; u oilalar uchun ikkinchi yangilik, demak bogʻlanish qoʻshish: «In addition,».
body.ru:
В уроке 1 мы назвали пять видов связи. Этот урок развивает два из них: порядок во времени и разницу между примером и добавлением.
Порядок во времени. Если предложения рассказывают о событиях, спросите, когда случилось второе:
• после первого: Then, Next, Later, Afterward
• до первого: Previously, Earlier (до этого)
• в то же время: Meanwhile
• последний из нескольких шагов: Finally
Пример или добавление? Спросите, что второе предложение делает с первым:
• приводит частный случай мысли первого предложения: For example, For instance
• добавляет новую мысль того же рода: In addition, Moreover
Пример: «The new playground in the mahalla has two swings and a slide. ___, a small free library opened next to it in May.» Библиотека — не частный случай детской площадки, а вторая новинка для семей, значит, связь — добавление: «In addition,».

body.en:
Worked example: "Our neighbour Rustam can repair almost anything in the house. ___, last week he fixed our broken radio in ten minutes with an old screwdriver."
1. Sentence 1: a general idea (he can repair almost anything).
2. Sentence 2: one case of that idea (the radio).
3. The link: a case of the idea before it, so example.
4. The answer: "For example,".
Now you: "The new reading room at the school is much quieter than the old one, since it sits at the far end of the building, away from the sports hall. ______ it has long wooden tables, so a whole study group can spread out its books and work together."
1. Sentence 1: one good point (the room is quiet).
2. Sentence 2: another good point (long tables), not a case of the quiet.
3. The link: a new point of the same kind, so addition.
4. The answer: ?
body.uz:
Yechilgan misol: «Our neighbour Rustam can repair almost anything in the house. ___, last week he fixed our broken radio in ten minutes with an old screwdriver.»
1. 1-gap: umumiy fikr (u uydagi deyarli hamma narsani tuzata oladi).
2. 2-gap: shu fikrning bitta holati (radio).
3. Bogʻlanish: oldingi fikrning bir holati, demak misol.
4. Javob: «For example,».
Endi siz: «The new reading room at the school is much quieter than the old one, since it sits at the far end of the building, away from the sports hall. ______ it has long wooden tables, so a whole study group can spread out its books and work together.»
1. 1-gap: bitta afzallik (xona sokin).
2. 2-gap: yana bir afzallik (uzun stollar), sokinlikning bir holati emas.
3. Bogʻlanish: xuddi shu turdagi yangi fikr, demak qoʻshish.
4. Javob: ?
body.ru:
Разбор: «Our neighbour Rustam can repair almost anything in the house. ___, last week he fixed our broken radio in ten minutes with an old screwdriver.»
1. Предложение 1: общая мысль (он может починить почти всё в доме).
2. Предложение 2: частный случай этой мысли (радио).
3. Связь: частный случай предыдущей мысли, значит, пример.
4. Ответ: «For example,».
Теперь попробуйте сами: «The new reading room at the school is much quieter than the old one, since it sits at the far end of the building, away from the sports hall. ______ it has long wooden tables, so a whole study group can spread out its books and work together.»
1. Предложение 1: одно достоинство (в зале тихо).
2. Предложение 2: ещё одно достоинство (длинные столы), а не частный случай тишины.
3. Связь: новая мысль того же рода, значит, добавление.
4. Ответ: ?

body.en:
Watch out for two traps.
1. The direction of time. "Previously," and "Earlier," point back: the second sentence happened before the first. Look for "had" and for words such as "years ago" or "that morning". "Later," and "Then," point forward.
2. A detail is not always an example. "For example," needs a general idea in the sentence before it, and the second sentence must be one case of that idea. If the first sentence is already a single fact, a second fact is an added point: "In addition," or "Moreover,".
Test your answer: put it in the blank and read both sentences again.
body.uz:
Ikki tuzoqdan ehtiyot boʻling.
1. Vaqt yoʻnalishi. «Previously,» va «Earlier,» orqaga ishora qiladi: ikkinchi gapdagi voqea birinchisidan oldin boʻlgan. «had» feʼlini va «years ago», «that morning» kabi soʻzlarni qidiring. «Later,» va «Then,» oldinga ishora qiladi.
2. Tafsilot har doim ham misol emas. «For example,» oldingi gapda umumiy fikrni talab qiladi, ikkinchi gap esa shu fikrning bitta holati boʻlishi kerak. Agar birinchi gap allaqachon bitta fakt boʻlsa, ikkinchi fakt qoʻshimcha fikr boʻladi: «In addition,» yoki «Moreover,».
Javobingizni tekshiring: uni boʻsh joyga qoʻyib, ikkala gapni qayta oʻqing.
body.ru:
Осторожно, две ловушки.
1. Направление времени. «Previously,» и «Earlier,» указывают назад: событие второго предложения было раньше первого. Ищите «had» и слова вроде «years ago» или «that morning». «Later,» и «Then,» указывают вперёд.
2. Деталь — не всегда пример. «For example,» требует общей мысли в предложении перед ним, а второе предложение должно быть её частным случаем. Если первое предложение — уже отдельный факт, второй факт — это добавление: «In addition,» или «Moreover,».
Проверьте ответ: вставьте его в пропуск и перечитайте оба предложения.

title.en: SAT R&W: Transitions: comparison, surprise, replacement and similarity
title.uz: SAT R&W: Transitions — qiyos, kutilmagan holat, almashtirish va oʻxshashlik
title.ru: SAT R&W: Transitions — сравнение, неожиданность, замена и сходство

body.en:
Lesson 1 put However, In contrast and Instead in one group. On the SAT they are not twins: each has its own job, and the near miss is often the trap.
• In contrast: two different things side by side. "Malika walks to school. Her brother, in contrast, takes the bus."
• However, Still, Nevertheless: what you expected did not happen. "The rain did not stop. Nevertheless, the match went on."
• Instead: one thing in place of another, often after "not" or a plan that was dropped. "The shop was closed. Instead, we bought bread at the market."
• Similarly, Likewise: the same pattern in a second case. "Our class prints on both sides of the paper. Likewise, the office reuses old pages for notes."
Ask what the sentence after the blank does: compares a second thing, breaks an expectation, replaces something, or repeats the pattern.
In a text of three or four sentences, the blank links its sentence to the one just before it.
body.uz:
1-darsda However, In contrast va Instead bir guruhda edi. SATda ular egizak emas: har birining oʻz vazifasi bor, tuzoq esa koʻpincha maʼnosi juda yaqin boʻlgan variant.
• In contrast: ikki xil narsa yonma-yon. «Malika walks to school. Her brother, in contrast, takes the bus.»
• However, Still, Nevertheless: kutilgan narsa boʻlmadi. «The rain did not stop. Nevertheless, the match went on.»
• Instead: bir narsa boshqasining oʻrnida, koʻpincha «not» yoki bekor qilingan rejadan keyin. «The shop was closed. Instead, we bought bread at the market.»
• Similarly, Likewise: ikkinchi holatda ham xuddi shu tartib. «Our class prints on both sides of the paper. Likewise, the office reuses old pages for notes.»
Boʻsh joydan keyingi gap nima qilishini soʻrang: ikkinchi narsani solishtiradimi, kutilganni buzadimi, biror narsaning oʻrnini oladimi yoki shu tartibni takrorlaydimi.
Uch-toʻrt gapli matnda boʻsh joy oʻz gapini aynan oldingi gap bilan bogʻlaydi.
body.ru:
В уроке 1 However, In contrast и Instead стояли в одной группе. На SAT они не близнецы: у каждого своя работа, а ловушка — часто похожий вариант.
• In contrast: две разные вещи рядом. «Malika walks to school. Her brother, in contrast, takes the bus.»
• However, Still, Nevertheless: ожидаемое не случилось. «The rain did not stop. Nevertheless, the match went on.»
• Instead: одно вместо другого, часто после «not» или отменённого плана. «The shop was closed. Instead, we bought bread at the market.»
• Similarly, Likewise: та же схема во втором случае. «Our class prints on both sides of the paper. Likewise, the office reuses old pages for notes.»
Спросите, что делает предложение после пропуска: сравнивает вторую вещь, нарушает ожидание, заменяет что-то или повторяет схему.
В тексте из трёх-четырёх предложений пропуск связывает своё предложение с тем, что стоит прямо перед ним.

body.en:
Worked example: "Rano was going to buy a cake for the family party. ___, she baked one herself, using an old recipe of her grandmother."
1. Sentence 1: a plan (buy a cake).
2. Sentence 2: what she did in place of that plan (she baked one).
3. The link: one thing in place of another, not two things compared and not a surprise.
4. The answer: "Instead,".
Now you: "Sardor had a bad cold on the morning of the class quiz, and his voice was almost gone. ______ he answered every question correctly, and his team won the quiz by two points."
1. Sentence 1: what makes you expect a bad result (a cold, almost no voice).
2. Sentence 2: the opposite happened (every answer right, a win).
3. The link: what was expected did not happen. Nothing is compared side by side, and nothing is replaced.
4. The answer: ?
body.uz:
Yechilgan misol: «Rano was going to buy a cake for the family party. ___, she baked one herself, using an old recipe of her grandmother.»
1. 1-gap: reja (tort sotib olish).
2. 2-gap: shu reja oʻrniga qilgan ishi (tortni oʻzi pishirdi).
3. Bogʻlanish: bir narsa boshqasining oʻrnida; ikki narsa solishtirilmaydi va kutilmagan holat ham yoʻq.
4. Javob: «Instead,».
Endi siz: «Sardor had a bad cold on the morning of the class quiz, and his voice was almost gone. ______ he answered every question correctly, and his team won the quiz by two points.»
1. 1-gap: yomon natijani kutishga sabab (shamollash, ovozi deyarli yoʻq).
2. 2-gap: aksi boʻldi (hamma javob toʻgʻri, gʻalaba).
3. Bogʻlanish: kutilgan narsa boʻlmadi. Hech narsa yonma-yon solishtirilmaydi va hech narsa almashtirilmaydi.
4. Javob: ?
body.ru:
Разбор: «Rano was going to buy a cake for the family party. ___, she baked one herself, using an old recipe of her grandmother.»
1. Предложение 1: план (купить торт).
2. Предложение 2: что она сделала вместо этого плана (испекла сама).
3. Связь: одно вместо другого; две вещи не сравниваются, и неожиданности нет.
4. Ответ: «Instead,».
Теперь попробуйте сами: «Sardor had a bad cold on the morning of the class quiz, and his voice was almost gone. ______ he answered every question correctly, and his team won the quiz by two points.»
1. Предложение 1: то, что заставляет ждать плохого результата (простуда, почти нет голоса).
2. Предложение 2: случилось обратное (все ответы верны, победа).
3. Связь: ожидаемое не случилось. Ничего не сравнивается рядом и ничего не заменяется.
4. Ответ: ?

body.en:
Watch out for two traps.
1. A different thing is not always a contrast. "Similarly," needs the second case to follow the same pattern as the first, even when the people or things differ. Two people who cook in opposite ways are a contrast; two different foods kept in the same way are a similarity.
2. Near misses. "In contrast," needs two things to compare; "Nevertheless," needs an expectation that fails; "Instead," needs something that is replaced. If the text has none of these, the word is wrong, however close it sounds.
Test: read the whole text again with your answer in the blank, the sentence after it too.
body.uz:
Ikki tuzoqdan ehtiyot boʻling.
1. Boshqa narsa har doim ham qarama-qarshilik emas. «Similarly,» ikkinchi holat birinchisi bilan bir xil tartibda boʻlishini talab qiladi, odamlar yoki narsalar boshqa boʻlsa ham. Ovqatni qarama-qarshi usulda pishiradigan ikki kishi — qarama-qarshilik; bir xil usulda saqlanadigan ikki xil ovqat — oʻxshashlik.
2. Yaqin variantlar. «In contrast,» solishtiriladigan ikki narsani talab qiladi; «Nevertheless,» amalga oshmagan kutilmani; «Instead,» almashtirilgan narsani. Matnda bularning hech biri boʻlmasa, soʻz qanchalik yaqin eshitilmasin, notoʻgʻri.
Sinov: javobni boʻsh joyga qoʻyib, butun matnni, undan keyingi gapni ham qayta oʻqing.
body.ru:
Осторожно, две ловушки.
1. Другая вещь — не всегда контраст. «Similarly,» требует, чтобы второй случай шёл по той же схеме, даже если люди или вещи другие. Два человека, которые готовят противоположными способами, — контраст; два разных продукта, которые хранят одинаково, — сходство.
2. Похожие варианты. «In contrast,» требует двух вещей для сравнения; «Nevertheless,» — ожидания, которое не сбылось; «Instead,» — того, что заменено. Если в тексте этого нет, слово неверно, как бы близко оно ни звучало.
Проверка: перечитайте весь текст с ответом в пропуске, и предложение после него тоже.

title.en: SAT R&W: Rhetorical Synthesis: comparison goals
title.uz: SAT R&W: Rhetorical Synthesis — solishtirish maqsadlari

body.en:
Lesson 1 found the goal's key word. Many goals ask you to compare; this lesson reads them closely.
Three kinds of comparison goal:
• stress a similarity: the answer says what both things share ("both", "each", "the same").
• stress a difference: the answer sets the two side by side and says how they differ ("while", "but", "whereas").
• compare by numbers: the answer gives both numbers and how they relate ("more than", "fewer than", "twice as many").
The right option names both things and the right relation. An option about one thing only cannot compare, however true it is.
Example. Notes: the chess club meets on Tuesdays; the drawing club meets on Thursdays; each club has 12 members. Goal: to stress a similarity between the clubs. Answer: "The chess club and the drawing club each have 12 members." The days differ, so they cannot be the similarity.
body.uz:
1-darsda maqsadning kalit soʻzini topdik. Koʻp maqsad solishtirishni soʻraydi; bu darsda ularni diqqat bilan oʻqiymiz.
Solishtirish maqsadining uch turi:
• stress a similarity (oʻxshashlikni taʼkidlash): javob ikkala narsada umumiy boʻlgan jihatni aytadi («both», «each», «the same»).
• stress a difference (farqni taʼkidlash): javob ikkalasini yonma-yon qoʻyib, qanday farq qilishini aytadi («while», «but», «whereas»).
• compare by numbers (sonlar bilan solishtirish): javob ikkala sonni va ular orasidagi nisbatni beradi («more than», «fewer than», «twice as many»).
Toʻgʻri variant ikkala narsani ham, ular orasidagi toʻgʻri munosabatni ham aytadi. Faqat bitta narsa haqidagi variant, qanchalik toʻgʻri boʻlmasin, solishtira olmaydi.
Misol. Qaydlar: chess club seshanba kunlari yigʻiladi; drawing club payshanba kunlari yigʻiladi; har bir toʻgarakda 12 aʼzo bor. Maqsad: «to stress a similarity between the clubs». Javob: «The chess club and the drawing club each have 12 members.» Kunlar har xil, shuning uchun ular oʻxshashlik boʻla olmaydi.
body.ru:
В уроке 1 мы находили ключевое слово цели. Многие цели просят сравнить; в этом уроке разберём их подробно.
Три вида целей-сравнений:
• stress a similarity (подчеркнуть сходство): ответ говорит, что общего у обеих вещей («both», «each», «the same»).
• stress a difference (подчеркнуть различие): ответ ставит их рядом и говорит, чем они различаются («while», «but», «whereas»).
• compare by numbers (сравнить числами): ответ даёт оба числа и их соотношение («more than», «fewer than», «twice as many»).
Верный вариант называет обе вещи и верное соотношение. Вариант только об одной вещи не сравнивает, как бы верен он ни был.
Пример. Заметки: chess club собирается по вторникам; drawing club — по четвергам; в каждом кружке 12 участников. Цель: «to stress a similarity between the clubs». Ответ: «The chess club and the drawing club each have 12 members.» Дни разные, поэтому они не могут быть сходством.

body.en:
Worked example. Notes:
• A school held a book swap.
• On the first day, 40 books changed hands.
• On the second day, 80 books changed hands.
Goal: to compare the two days by numbers.
1. Key word: compare, with numbers.
2. The answer needs both days, both numbers and the relation: 80 is twice 40.
3. The answer: "Twice as many books changed hands on the second day (80) as on the first (40)."
Now you. Notes:
• A bakery near the school sells two kinds of bread.
• It bakes 150 round loaves every morning.
• It bakes 50 long loaves every morning.
• The round loaves are usually sold out by noon.
Goal: to compare how many loaves of each kind the bakery bakes.
1. Key word: compare how many, so by numbers.
2. The answer needs both kinds, both numbers and the relation between 150 and 50.
3. The answer: ?
body.uz:
Yechilgan misol. Notes:
• A school held a book swap.
• On the first day, 40 books changed hands.
• On the second day, 80 books changed hands.
Goal: to compare the two days by numbers.
1. Kalit soʻz: compare (solishtirish), sonlar bilan.
2. Javobga ikkala kun, ikkala son va nisbat kerak: 80 soni 40 ning ikki baravari.
3. Javob: «Twice as many books changed hands on the second day (80) as on the first (40).»
Endi siz. Notes:
• A bakery near the school sells two kinds of bread.
• It bakes 150 round loaves every morning.
• It bakes 50 long loaves every morning.
• The round loaves are usually sold out by noon.
Goal: to compare how many loaves of each kind the bakery bakes.
1. Kalit soʻz: compare how many (nechtadan), demak sonlar bilan.
2. Javobga ikkala non turi, ikkala son va 150 bilan 50 orasidagi nisbat kerak.
3. Javob: ?
body.ru:
Разбор. Заметки:
• A school held a book swap.
• On the first day, 40 books changed hands.
• On the second day, 80 books changed hands.
Цель: «to compare the two days by numbers».
1. Ключевое слово: compare (сравнить), числами.
2. В ответе нужны оба дня, оба числа и соотношение: 80 — вдвое больше 40.
3. Ответ: «Twice as many books changed hands on the second day (80) as on the first (40).»
Теперь попробуйте сами. Заметки:
• A bakery near the school sells two kinds of bread.
• It bakes 150 round loaves every morning.
• It bakes 50 long loaves every morning.
• The round loaves are usually sold out by noon.
Цель: «to compare how many loaves of each kind the bakery bakes».
1. Ключевое слово: compare how many (сколько), значит, числами.
2. В ответе нужны оба вида хлеба, оба числа и соотношение между 150 и 50.
3. Ответ: ?

body.en:
Watch out for three traps.
1. Both things, the wrong relation. An option can name both things and still miss the goal. For a difference goal, a sentence with "both" shows a similarity; for a similarity goal, a sentence with "while" or "but" shows a difference.
2. The wrong numbers. Check the arithmetic: 60 is twice 30, not three times; "fewer" must point at the smaller number, "more" at the bigger one.
3. The other comparison. If the goal compares how many pupils came, a sentence that compares the prices is off the goal, even with two numbers in it.
body.uz:
Uch tuzoqdan ehtiyot boʻling.
1. Ikkala narsa bor, lekin munosabat notoʻgʻri. Variant ikkala narsani aytib ham maqsaddan chetga chiqishi mumkin. Farq maqsadida «both» li gap oʻxshashlikni koʻrsatadi; oʻxshashlik maqsadida «while» yoki «but» li gap farqni koʻrsatadi.
2. Notoʻgʻri sonlar. Hisobni tekshiring: 60 soni 30 ning ikki baravari, uch baravari emas; «fewer» kichik songa, «more» katta songa ishora qilishi kerak.
3. Boshqa solishtirish. Maqsad nechta oʻquvchi kelganini solishtirsa, narxlarni solishtirgan gap, ikkita son boʻlsa ham, maqsaddan chetda.
body.ru:
Осторожно, три ловушки.
1. Обе вещи, но не то соотношение. Вариант может назвать обе вещи и всё же не достичь цели. Для цели-различия предложение с «both» показывает сходство; для цели-сходства предложение с «while» или «but» показывает различие.
2. Неверные числа. Проверьте арифметику: 60 — вдвое больше 30, а не втрое; «fewer» должно указывать на меньшее число, «more» — на большее.
3. Не то сравнение. Если цель сравнивает, сколько пришло учеников, предложение, которое сравнивает цены, цели не отвечает, даже если в нём два числа.

title.en: SAT R&W: Rhetorical Synthesis: introduce, explain, present, describe
title.uz: SAT R&W: Rhetorical Synthesis — tanishtirish, tushuntirish, natija, usul
title.ru: SAT R&W: Rhetorical Synthesis — представить, объяснить, изложить результат, описать способ

body.en:
When the goal does not compare, its verb picks the answer. Read the verb first, then what it is about.
• introduce X (to readers who do not know it): say what X is, in general terms.
• explain why or how: give the reason ("because", "so that") or the way ("by").
• present a result or a finding: say what happened in the end, often with a number.
• describe the method or the steps: say how it was done, in order.
Then check the size the goal asks for:
• an overview: the whole thing in one sentence (what it is, who, what it does).
• one aspect or one detail: the single fact the goal names, nothing else.
Example goal: "to explain why the club meets at 7:30". Right: "The club meets at 7:30 so that members can use the lab before lessons." A sentence with only the time and the room does not explain.
body.uz:
Maqsad solishtirishni soʻramasa, javobni maqsaddagi feʼl belgilaydi. Avval feʼlni, keyin u nima haqida ekanini oʻqing.
• introduce X (uni bilmaydiganlarga tanishtirish): X nima ekanini umumiy qilib ayting.
• explain why or how (nega yoki qanday): sababni («because», «so that») yoki usulni («by») bering.
• present a result or a finding (natija yoki topilma): oxirida nima boʻlganini ayting, koʻpincha son bilan.
• describe the method or the steps (usul yoki qadamlar): qanday qilinganini tartib bilan ayting.
Keyin maqsad qanchalik keng javob soʻrashini tekshiring:
• an overview (umumiy koʻrinish): hammasi bitta gapda (nima, kim, nima qiladi).
• one aspect or one detail (bitta jihat yoki tafsilot): faqat maqsad aytgan bitta fakt.
Misol maqsad: «to explain why the club meets at 7:30». Toʻgʻri: «The club meets at 7:30 so that members can use the lab before lessons.» Faqat vaqt va xonani aytgan gap tushuntirmaydi.
body.ru:
Если цель не сравнивает, ответ определяется её глаголом. Сначала прочитайте глагол, потом то, о чём речь.
• introduce X (тем, кто не знает): скажите, что такое X, в общих словах.
• explain why or how (почему или как): дайте причину («because», «so that») или способ («by»).
• present a result or a finding (результат или вывод): скажите, что вышло в конце, часто с числом.
• describe the method or the steps (способ или шаги): скажите, как это делали, по порядку.
Затем проверьте, какой объём просит цель:
• an overview (обзор): всё целиком в одном предложении (что это, кто, что делает).
• one aspect or one detail (один аспект или деталь): только тот факт, который назван в цели.
Пример цели: «to explain why the club meets at 7:30». Верно: «The club meets at 7:30 so that members can use the lab before lessons.» Предложение только со временем и комнатой не объясняет.

body.en:
Worked example. Notes:
• The homework club meets in Room 14 after lessons.
• Older pupils help younger ones with their homework.
• It is free and open to everyone in Grades 5 to 7.
Goal: to introduce the homework club to new pupils.
1. Verb: introduce, so say what the club is, in general terms.
2. A single detail, such as the room number, is too narrow.
3. The answer: "The homework club is a free after-school club where older pupils help pupils in Grades 5 to 7 with their homework."
Now you. Notes:
• The bus stop near the school moved 200 meters up the road in May.
• The old stop was right after a sharp bend.
• Drivers coming round the bend could not see children standing at the stop.
• Drivers can see the new stop from far away.
Goal: to explain why the bus stop was moved.
1. Verb: explain why, so the answer needs the reason.
2. A sentence that only says where or when the stop moved is out, and so is one that gives a fact without linking it to the move.
3. The answer: ?
body.uz:
Yechilgan misol. Notes:
• The homework club meets in Room 14 after lessons.
• Older pupils help younger ones with their homework.
• It is free and open to everyone in Grades 5 to 7.
Goal: to introduce the homework club to new pupils.
1. Feʼl: introduce (tanishtirish), demak toʻgarak nima ekanini umumiy qilib ayting.
2. Xona raqami kabi bitta tafsilot juda tor.
3. Javob: «The homework club is a free after-school club where older pupils help pupils in Grades 5 to 7 with their homework.»
Endi siz. Notes:
• The bus stop near the school moved 200 meters up the road in May.
• The old stop was right after a sharp bend.
• Drivers coming round the bend could not see children standing at the stop.
• Drivers can see the new stop from far away.
Goal: to explain why the bus stop was moved.
1. Feʼl: explain why (nega ekanini tushuntirish), demak javobga sabab kerak.
2. Bekat qayerga yoki qachon koʻchganini aytgan gap toʻgʻri kelmaydi; faktni koʻchish bilan bogʻlamay aytgan gap ham toʻgʻri kelmaydi.
3. Javob: ?
body.ru:
Разбор. Заметки:
• The homework club meets in Room 14 after lessons.
• Older pupils help younger ones with their homework.
• It is free and open to everyone in Grades 5 to 7.
Цель: «to introduce the homework club to new pupils».
1. Глагол: introduce (представить), значит, скажите, что это за кружок, в общих словах.
2. Одна деталь, например номер кабинета, слишком узка.
3. Ответ: «The homework club is a free after-school club where older pupils help pupils in Grades 5 to 7 with their homework.»
Теперь попробуйте сами. Заметки:
• The bus stop near the school moved 200 meters up the road in May.
• The old stop was right after a sharp bend.
• Drivers coming round the bend could not see children standing at the stop.
• Drivers can see the new stop from far away.
Цель: «to explain why the bus stop was moved».
1. Глагол: explain why (объяснить почему), значит, нужна причина.
2. Предложение только о том, куда или когда перенесли остановку, отпадает; и то, где факт не связан с переносом, тоже.
3. Ответ: ?

body.en:
Watch out for three traps.
1. The detail for an overview. A goal such as "to introduce the fair to readers who have never been" needs the general sentence: what it is, when, what happens. A vivid detail is true but too narrow.
2. The overview for a detail. A goal such as "to emphasize how long the work took" needs that one fact. A sentence that sums up everything hides it.
3. The neighbouring verb. Saying what something is does not explain why it happens, and the steps of a test are not its result.
body.uz:
Uch tuzoqdan ehtiyot boʻling.
1. Umumiy koʻrinish oʻrniga tafsilot. «to introduce the fair to readers who have never been» kabi maqsad umumiy gapni talab qiladi: nima, qachon, nima boʻladi. Yorqin tafsilot toʻgʻri, lekin juda tor.
2. Tafsilot oʻrniga umumiy koʻrinish. «to emphasize how long the work took» kabi maqsadga faqat shu bitta fakt kerak. Hammasini jamlagan gap uni yashiradi.
3. Qoʻshni feʼl. Biror narsa nima ekanini aytish uning nega boʻlishini tushuntirmaydi, tajriba qadamlari esa uning natijasi emas.
body.ru:
Осторожно, три ловушки.
1. Деталь вместо обзора. Цель вроде «to introduce the fair to readers who have never been» требует общего предложения: что это, когда, что там бывает. Яркая деталь верна, но слишком узка.
2. Обзор вместо детали. Цели вроде «to emphasize how long the work took» нужен один этот факт. Предложение, которое подводит итог всему, его прячет.
3. Соседний глагол. Сказать, что это такое, не значит объяснить, почему это происходит, а шаги опыта — не его результат.

stem.en:
Every Friday after lessons, the school garden club works in the vegetable beds behind the gym. First, the members pull the weeds between the rows of onions. ______ they water each bed with a long green hose.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

options.en: Then,
Previously,
For example,
In contrast,

why.en: Watering comes after weeding, the next step of the same afternoon: 'Then,'. 'Previously,' would put the watering before the weeding.
why.uz: Sugʻorish oʻtoqdan keyin keladi, oʻsha kunning keyingi qadami: «Then,». «Previously,» sugʻorishni oʻtoqdan oldinga qoʻyardi.
why.ru: Полив идёт после прополки, это следующий шаг того же дня: «Then,». «Previously,» поставило бы полив до прополки.

instructions.en: Choose the linking word or phrase that fits the logic between the ideas.
instructions.uz: Fikrlar orasidagi mantiqqa mos keladigan bogʻlovchi soʻz yoki iborani tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите связующее слово или выражение, которое передаёт логическую связь между мыслями.

stem.en:
The new reading room at the school is much quieter than the old one, since it sits at the far end of the building, away from the sports hall. ______ it has long wooden tables, so a whole study group can spread out its books and work together.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

options.en: In addition,
For example,
However,
As a result,

why.en: Long tables are a second good point of the same kind as the quiet, not a case of it: 'In addition,'. 'For example,' needs a general claim before it.
why.uz: Uzun stollar sokinlik kabi yana bir afzallik, uning bir holati emas: «In addition,». «For example,» oldidan umumiy fikrni talab qiladi.
why.ru: Длинные столы — второе достоинство того же рода, что и тишина, а не её частный случай: «In addition,». «For example,» требует общей мысли.

instructions.en: Choose the linking word or phrase that fits the logic between the ideas.
instructions.uz: Fikrlar orasidagi mantiqqa mos keladigan bogʻlovchi soʻz yoki iborani tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите связующее слово или выражение, которое передаёт логическую связь между мыслями.

stem.en:
Today the little shop at the bus stop sells only bread and flat cakes, and it closes at noon. ______ the same shop had sold sweets, cold drinks and school notebooks, and it had stayed open until late in the evening.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

options.en: Previously,
Later,
Meanwhile,
For example,

why.en: 'Had sold' and 'had stayed' tell what the shop did before today, so the link points back in time: 'Previously,'. 'Later,' points forward.
why.uz: «Had sold» va «had stayed» doʻkon bugungidan oldin nima qilganini aytadi, demak bogʻlanish orqaga ishora qiladi: «Previously,». «Later,» esa oldinga ishora qiladi.
why.ru: «Had sold» и «had stayed» говорят о том, что было до сегодняшнего дня, значит, связь указывает назад: «Previously,».

instructions.en: Choose the linking word or phrase that fits the logic between the ideas.
instructions.uz: Fikrlar orasidagi mantiqqa mos keladigan bogʻlovchi soʻz yoki iborani tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите связующее слово или выражение, которое передаёт логическую связь между мыслями.

stem.en:
In the school garden, the tomato plants need full sun, so the club grows them in the bed along the south wall. ______ the mint needs shade and damp soil, so it grows in the corner under the old apricot tree.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

options.en: In contrast,
Similarly,
Nevertheless,
For example,

why.en: Two plants with opposite needs, sun and shade, are set side by side: 'In contrast,'. Nothing expected fails, so not 'Nevertheless,'.
why.uz: Qarama-qarshi ehtiyojli ikki oʻsimlik, quyosh va soya, yonma-yon qoʻyilgan: «In contrast,». Kutilgan narsa amalga oshmay qolgani yoʻq, shuning uchun «Nevertheless,» emas.
why.ru: Два растения с противоположными потребностями, солнце и тень, поставлены рядом: «In contrast,». Ожидание не нарушено, поэтому не «Nevertheless,».

instructions.en: Choose the linking word or phrase that fits the logic between the ideas.
instructions.uz: Fikrlar orasidagi mantiqqa mos keladigan bogʻlovchi soʻz yoki iborani tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите связующее слово или выражение, которое передаёт логическую связь между мыслями.

stem.en:
Sardor had a bad cold on the morning of the class quiz, and his voice was almost gone. ______ he answered every question correctly, and his team won the quiz by two points.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

options.en: Nevertheless,
For example,
In contrast,
Similarly,

why.en: A sick boy would be expected to do worse, yet he got every answer right: 'Nevertheless,'. Nothing is compared or replaced.
why.uz: Kasal boladan yomonroq natija kutilardi, lekin u hammasiga toʻgʻri javob berdi: «Nevertheless,». Hech narsa solishtirilmagan yoki almashtirilmagan.
why.ru: От больного мальчика ждали худшего, а он ответил на всё верно: «Nevertheless,». Ничего не сравнивается и не заменяется.

instructions.en: Choose the linking word or phrase that fits the logic between the ideas.
instructions.uz: Fikrlar orasidagi mantiqqa mos keladigan bogʻlovchi soʻz yoki iborani tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите связующее слово или выражение, которое передаёт логическую связь между мыслями.

stem.en:
Nodir's grandmother keeps her bread fresh by wrapping it in a cotton cloth, because she says plastic bags make the crust soft and damp. ______ she stores her dried apricots in cloth bags hung by the window, never in plastic boxes, so that the fruit stays dry. Her kitchen has almost no plastic in it at all.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

options.en: Similarly,
In contrast,
Nevertheless,
For example,

why.en: The apricots follow the same rule as the bread, cloth and never plastic: 'Similarly,'. A different food is not a contrast when the pattern is the same.
why.uz: Oʻrik ham non kabi bir qoidaga boʻysunadi: mato, plastik emas: «Similarly,». Tartib bir xil boʻlsa, boshqa ovqat qarama-qarshilik emas.
why.ru: Курага подчиняется тому же правилу, что и хлеб: ткань, а не пластик: «Similarly,». Другая еда — не контраст, если схема та же.

instructions.en: Choose the linking word or phrase that fits the logic between the ideas.
instructions.uz: Fikrlar orasidagi mantiqqa mos keladigan bogʻlovchi soʻz yoki iborani tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите связующее слово или выражение, которое передаёт логическую связь между мыслями.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Two classes went on trips in May.
• Class 6A visited a farm outside the city.
• Class 6B visited a bread factory.
• Each trip lasted six hours, including the bus ride.

The student wants to emphasize a similarity between the two trips.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Each of the two class trips in May lasted six hours, including the bus ride.
In May, Class 6A visited a farm outside the city, while Class 6B visited a bread factory.
Class 6B spent six hours on its May trip to a bread factory.
Class 6A went on a trip to a farm outside the city in May.

why.en: A similarity must be true of both trips: each lasted six hours. The farm and the factory are a difference, and two choices name one class only.
why.uz: Oʻxshashlik ikkala sayohatga ham tegishli boʻlishi kerak: har biri olti soat davom etdi. Ferma va zavod — farq, ikki javob esa bitta sinf haqida.
why.ru: Сходство должно касаться обеих поездок: каждая длилась шесть часов. Ферма и завод — различие, а два варианта — только об одном классе.

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• A bakery near the school sells two kinds of bread.
• It bakes 150 round loaves every morning.
• It bakes 50 long loaves every morning.
• The round loaves are usually sold out by noon.

The student wants to compare how many loaves of each kind the bakery bakes.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Every morning, the bakery bakes 150 round loaves, three times as many as the 50 long loaves it bakes.
The bakery near the school bakes 150 round loaves every morning, and they are usually sold out by noon.
The bakery near the school sells two kinds of bread: round loaves and long loaves.
Every morning, the bakery near the school bakes 50 long loaves.

why.en: Comparing how many needs both kinds and both numbers: 150 round loaves, three times the 50 long ones. The other choices give one kind or no number.
why.uz: Sonini solishtirish uchun ikkala tur va ikkala son kerak: 150 dumaloq non 50 ta uzun nonning uch baravari. Qolganlarida bitta tur yoki son yoʻq.
why.ru: Для сравнения количества нужны оба вида и оба числа: 150 круглых — втрое больше 50 длинных. В других один вид или нет чисел.

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Two neighbours, Saida and Bahodir, keep hens in their yards.
• Saida keeps 12 hens.
• Bahodir keeps 4 hens.
• Both sell their eggs at the Friday market.

The student wants to emphasize a difference between the two neighbours.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Saida keeps 12 hens, three times as many as the 4 that Bahodir keeps.
Saida and Bahodir both keep hens in their yards and sell the eggs at the Friday market.
Saida keeps 12 hens, twice as many as the 4 that Bahodir keeps.
Bahodir keeps 4 hens in his yard and sells their eggs at the Friday market.

why.en: A difference needs both neighbours and the right relation: 12 is three times 4, not twice. 'Both … sell' shows a similarity.
why.uz: Farq uchun ikkala qoʻshni va toʻgʻri nisbat kerak: 12 soni 4 ning uch baravari, ikki emas. «Both … sell» oʻxshashlikni koʻrsatadi.
why.ru: Для различия нужны оба соседа и верное соотношение: 12 — втрое больше 4, а не вдвое. «Both … sell» показывает сходство.

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Pupils in Class 8D wanted to find out where in the school it is noisiest.
• They placed a phone with a sound-level app in four places: the canteen, the gym, the library and a corridor.
• They measured for ten minutes in each place during the lunch break.
• The canteen was the noisiest place.

The student wants to describe how the pupils measured the noise.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: During the lunch break, the pupils measured the sound for ten minutes in each of four places with a phone app.
The pupils found that the canteen was the noisiest place in the school.
Class 8D wanted to find out where in the school it is noisiest.
The canteen, the gym, the library and a corridor are four places in the school.

why.en: 'How they measured' is the method: a phone app, four places, ten minutes each at lunch. The canteen being noisiest is the result.
why.uz: «How they measured» — usul: telefon ilovasi, toʻrt joy, tushlikda har birida oʻn daqiqa. Oshxona eng shovqinli ekani — natija.
why.ru: «How they measured» — это способ: приложение, четыре места, по десять минут в обед. Самая шумная столовая — результат.

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• The bus stop near the school moved 200 meters up the road in May.
• The old stop was right after a sharp bend.
• Drivers coming round the bend could not see children standing at the stop.
• Drivers can see the new stop from far away.

The student wants to explain why the bus stop was moved.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: The stop was moved because drivers coming round the sharp bend could not see the children waiting there.
In May, the bus stop near the school moved 200 meters up the road.
Drivers can now see the new bus stop from far away.
The old bus stop near the school was right after a sharp bend in the road.

why.en: 'Why' needs the reason: drivers coming round the bend could not see the children. A fact about the bend alone does not say why the stop moved.
why.uz: «Why» sababni talab qiladi: burilishdan chiqqan haydovchilar bolalarni koʻra olmagan. Burilish haqidagi faktning oʻzi sababni aytmaydi.
why.ru: «Why» требует причины: водители из-за поворота не видели детей. Один факт о повороте не объясняет перенос.

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• The "night library" is held in the school library on the last Friday of every month.
• From 6 to 9 p.m., families come to read together.
• Children can bring a pillow and read on the floor.
• Volunteers read stories aloud to the youngest children.
• At the last night library, 64 people came.
• Tea and bread are served at 7:30.

The student wants to introduce the night library to parents who have not heard of it.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: On the last Friday of each month, the school library holds a night library, where families come from 6 to 9 p.m. to read together.
Children who come to the night library can bring a pillow and read on the floor.
At the last night library, 64 people came, more than at any other school event this year.
Volunteers at the night library read stories aloud to the youngest children, and tea is served at 7:30.

why.en: New parents need what it is, when and for whom: families reading together at school on one Friday evening a month. A pillow is a vivid detail.
why.uz: Bilmaydigan ota-onaga bu nima, qachon va kim uchun ekani kerak: oyda bir juma kechqurun maktabda oilaviy oʻqish. Yostiq — tafsilot.
why.ru: Новым родителям нужно, что это, когда и для кого: семьи читают вместе в школе раз в месяц в пятницу вечером. Подушка — деталь.
